title: Simple but powerful
body: Yet to find a more convenient way of making notes, photos, web links, lists available across my various devices seamlessly. An easy way to send items to myself on other devices. Then there’s other useful tools like grabbing text from images which I use frequently. Very easy to use, in a simple interface, yet a powerful tool.
author: tonyacquah

title: Best note ever
body: What can I say. This note has saved my entire songs from losing. It has become the most important thing to me. And what marvels me is that I can have all of them on different phone and with my email account. It so amazing. 😇😍
author: Uly Monday

title: Neat And Genuine Way To Keep Moments
body: Google Keep gives you a neat way to organize your thoughts with accurate date and times to keep a journal
author: Frank A Duodu

title: Try this App
body: The best note taking app I have ever used. It keeps you organized no matter the device you are working with.

title: Most useful app
body: This is the best app for taking notes and other important documentations, however add some formatting functionalities to make it like iPhones notes

title: Security features
body: It will be best if you add a security feature, like password to lock the app

title: notifcation not going away
body: Whenever you remove a link preview and the notification pops up with the option to UNDO, it stays on the screen for way too long. Almost a minute and you can’t even clear it away unless you wait it out or restart the app. It’s really annoying. Grateful if you could resolve this. Thank you.
author: ESTHER Y. LARYEA

title: This app is cutting away parts of my work.
body: I’ve been using this app for years and I love it.  However, this this year parts of the works I save on it just gets missing. This is the second time this year and I’m so unhappy. Weeks of my time, effort and money invested gone.
